$comment: ADR-422: dedicated tier-2 motorboat art (motorboat, pontoon, speedboat). The atlases have NO image files of their own: their pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/task421-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the Task 34 / ADR-361 pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the image/ktx2 paths below are never fetched. They point at a real pack atlas only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Vehicle layout: 4 cols x 6 rows of the def's frame (two rows per throttle phase 0-2 — 0 idle, 1 full throttle, 2 cruise — Art order E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N,NE in row-major order); frame(phase, dir) = phase*8 + dir, so the idle animation is frames [8] (full throttle) and the wake animation cycles [0, 8, 16] at 4 fps. resolveVehicleArt binds these by def id (sprite key == def id, first animation 8 directions, veh_art_* atlas = native scale).
name: survivaz-task422
